title: Box 21, opened
logline: Box 21 open on the table for the first time since 2021: the first private pages, the blue-pencil grid on the top sheet, the garage from the doorway drawn straight across it. The register on the lid beside it. He reads his own first page.

panels.composition: A cardboard box open on a drafting table with its top sheet showing a drawing over a faint blue-pencil grid, the box's lid beside it with pencilled lines, a man's hands at the frame's edge.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a cardboard box open on a drafting table with its top sheet showing a drawing over a faint blue-pencil grid, the lid beside it with pencilled lines and a man's hands at the frame's edge, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
